## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-ON. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Commodity and energy leadership — XLE (1W: +2.41% | 1M: +12.27%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +15.60% | 1M: +24.36%) ABOVE TREND — plus SPY_TLT in RECOVERY (1W: +0.31% | 1M: -3.62%) provide confirmation, while rising VXX (1W: +7.63% | 1M: +12.83%) ABOVE TREND signals localized volatility ↑ rising.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear increasing: VXX (1W: +7.63% | 1M: +12.83%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising. Credit stress edging up: HYG (1W: -0.16% | 1M: +0.03%) CORRECTION and LQD (1W: -0.27% | 1M: +1.17%) CORRECTION signal tighter conditions. Speculative flows showing resilience: ARKK (1W: +1.89% | 1M: +0.77%) ABOVE TREND and IBIT (1W: +5.63% | 1M: -6.29%) RECOVERY.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-tight: TLT (1W: -0.52% | 1M: +3.35%) CORRECTION while SPY_TLT is in RECOVERY (1W: +0.31% | 1M: -3.62%) — equity risk premia mixed; Dollar strength ↑ rising (Level 27.41 1W: +1.14%) exerting headwind on internationals.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Energy leading: XLE (1W: +2.41% | 1M: +12.27%) ABOVE TREND; Real Estate showing strength: XLRE (1W: +0.74% | 1M: +6.84%) ABOVE TREND; Tech weak: XLK (1W: -2.22% | 1M: -3.73%) BELOW TREND and Financials weak: XLF (1W: -0.71% | 1M: -4.68%) BELOW TREND — style mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. US vs Global?**
US softer but less damaged than EM: SPY (1W: -1.16% | 1M: -1.48%) BELOW TREND while EEM (1W: -6.73% | 1M: -0.39%) BELOW TREND and FXI (1W: -5.75% | 1M: -7.56%) BELOW TREND show deeper weakness; Europe and Japan lag on a 1W basis.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation intact: ARKK (1W: +1.89% | 1M: +0.77%) ABOVE TREND and IBIT (1W: +5.63% | 1M: -6.29%) RECOVERY indicate risk-on positioning despite IWM (1W: -1.07% | 1M: -0.16%) BELOW TREND.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Broad commodity rally led by oil: USO (1W: +14.84% | 1M: +21.55%) ABOVE TREND and UGA (1W: +12.16% | 1M: +21.95%) ABOVE TREND; gold taking profits with GLD (1W: -0.34% | 1M: +10.46%) CORRECTION.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy confirmed: XLE (1W: +2.41% | 1M: +12.27%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +15.60% | 1M: +24.36%) ABOVE TREND; natural gas mixed with UNG (1W: +1.55% | 1M: -7.24%) RECOVERY.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Commodity/energy leadership via XLE and BNO plus SPY_TLT RECOVERY — two independent confirmations of risk-on internals. DIVERGENCE: rising VXX (1W: +7.63% | 1M: +12.83%) ABOVE TREND and credit signals (HYG/LQD CORRECTION) create a minor divergence to monitor.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposure to energy and commodity-linked ETFs (XLE, BNO) and monitor real estate (XLRE) for carry; reduce exposure to areas showing weakness such as XLK (1W: -2.22% | 1M: -3.73%) BELOW TREND and XLF (1W: -0.71% | 1M: -4.68%) BELOW TREND.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLE (1W: +2.41% | 1M: +12.27%) and XLRE (1W: +0.74% | 1M: +6.84%) if oil momentum continues. BEARISH: XLK (1W: -2.22% | 1M: -3.73%) and XLF (1W: -0.71% | 1M: -4.68%) if volatility persists.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: BNO (1W: +15.60% | 1M: +24.36%) and USO (1W: +14.84% | 1M: +21.55%) on tight supply cues. BEARISH: GLD (1W: -0.34% | 1M: +10.46%) if real yields firm and risk premia compress.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX 30 (elevated complacency threshold; current VXX (1W: +7.63% | 1M: +12.83%) ABOVE TREND). HYG/LQD ~0.72 (credit stress marker; current credit spread Level 0.7245 1W: +0.26% RECOVERY). XLK/XLF ratio 2.72 (watch for rotation inflection).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Energy and commodities showing strength (XLE and BNO ABOVE TREND). Key risk: rising volatility (VXX ABOVE TREND ↑ rising) and signs of credit stress (HYG/LQD CORRECTION) that could puncture the rally.
